error.status.400.caption: Bad Request
error.status.400.title: That request didn't quite parse.
error.status.400.description: Something about what was sent doesn't make sense to us. Double-check the link and try again.
error.status.401.caption: Unauthorized
error.status.401.title: Badge check, please.
error.status.401.description: You'll need to sign in before this page will talk to you.
error.status.403.caption: Forbidden
error.status.403.title: Nice try. Still no.
error.status.403.description: Your account doesn't have access to this one, even signed in.
error.status.404.caption: Not Found
error.status.404.title: You've wandered off the map.
error.status.404.description: There's nothing here — the page moved, got renamed, or never existed. Let's get you back on track.
error.status.429.caption: Too Many Requests
error.status.429.title: Whoa there, speed racer!
error.status.429.description: You've been clicking around a little too fast. Take a breather and try again shortly.
error.status.429.descriptionWithRetry: You've been clicking around a little too fast — try again in about {seconds}s.
error.status.500.caption: Internal Server Error
error.status.500.title: Something short-circuited on our end.
error.status.500.description: Our server tripped over its own cable. We've been notified — please try again.
error.status.501.caption: Not Implemented
error.status.501.title: This one's still in the oven.
error.status.501.description: This feature doesn't exist yet — but you've found a very early preview of the "coming soon" page.
error.status.503.caption: Service Unavailable
error.status.503.title: Taking a quick nap.
error.status.503.description: This part of the site couldn't load its data just now. We'll be back in a moment — try again shortly.
error.status.503.descriptionWithRetry: This part of the site is catching its breath — try again in about {seconds}s.
